tagline: Run a tower crane. Stack crates against the clock, or build freely from three trucks of crates, containers and weld joints.
description:
Sky Flow is a 3D tower crane game. A truck brings in the load. Lower the hook, grab it, swing it over open ground and set it down. Wind pushes the load, and the outline under it shows where it will land.

Timed build gives you three minutes to stack crates as high as they will stand, and keeps your best score.

Free build has no clock. Three trucks wait at the edge of the site: one with crates, one with long shipping containers, one with weld joints. Each brings a new piece after you take one. Turn and Flip swing the load a quarter turn, so a container can lie either way or stand on end. Anything set flush against a joint is welded to it, and a welded shape lifts, turns and falls as one piece. Tall pieces go over when you knock them, so mind the hook.

Slew, run the trolley in and out and hoist with the on screen buttons, or use the keyboard on desktop. Drag to turn the camera and pinch to zoom.

The free demo includes three timed rounds and twelve placements in Free build. Buy it for unlimited timed rounds and unlimited Free build.

Plays in your phone or desktop browser. Version 2.1.
